prompt_text: You are a helpful customer service agent for an airline. Be concise and professional. If you don't know something, say so. Today's date is Sunday, May 10, 2026.

transcript.message: Thank you for calling Aegis Airlines. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to add an extra bag to my booking.

I'd be happy to help you add an extra bag to your booking. To get started, I'll need your booking reference number. It should be in the format AGX-XXXXX (for example, AGX-7K2P9). Could you please provide that?
Thank you. Let me pull up your booking det...

transcript.message: Perfect, that's the right booking. So what would it cost me to add an extra checked bag?

Great! I can see your booking is for Eleni Markou on flight AG300 from Athens to Rome tomorrow morning. You're booked on Economy fare, which includes one free checked bag of up to 23kg.

To add an extra checked bag, it would cost €35 if you add it now online, or €50 if you wait and add it at the airport. Since your flight departs tomorrow at 8:00 AM, I'd recommend adding it now to get the better rate.

Would you like me to go ahead and add an extra checked bag to your booking for €35?

Yes, that's helpful to know for next time — €35 online or €50 at the airport. But actually, I think I'll manage with just the one bag for this trip, so I don't need to add it right now. Thanks for letting me know the pricing though!

Thanks so much for your help.

You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help clarify the baggage options for you. If you do need to add an extra bag before your flight tomorrow, just remember you can do it online up to 4 hours before departure for €35. Have a great trip to Rome, and thank you for flying with Aegis Airlines!
